verses.pali: Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge.
verses.english: Someone with three qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Attanā ca pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, parañca pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti …pe….
verses.english: They don’t themselves kill living creatures. They encourage others to not kill living creatures. And they approve of not killing living creatures. …
